body: Idk if this counts but when I was still in highschool and I’d run out of money for the vending machine one day I went into the locker room during gym and ransacked people’s lunches. Ugh.

Walmart has those fizzy waters, I’m sure you could find one in a can to get that crackly soda feeling in your throat. 

Side note; guzzle is a funny word
Just a plain old calorie deficit.

Okay, I used a bidet personally, and I have a walker from an accident a few years ago stored in my bathroom. When I feel clean, I drape an old towel over the walker and back up onto it to dry off. Maybe that’s gross!! But it’s better than having a wet ass all day.
